text:
GENERATE BURST KL-4-W — Run C-9 P4, the knight's turnaround by EDIT from the approved ladder frame, direction W. task_id "KL-4-W".

Use image_gen in EDIT mode on IMAGE 1 (a knight painted in the hand of a c. 1530 Flemish manuscript, at the game camera, background flat green). KEEP THE PAINTER'S HAND exactly: the same line, hatching, uneven washes, gouache-like steel with its small dark pits, worn pigment and imperfections; the blue tabard with gold cross-crosslets and gold bands, loose cloth, short open side flaps and red lining; the helm; the plate armour; the pollaxe (flared axe blade with a little brass, hammer back, top spike). IMAGE 2 is the original manuscript miniature: match its hand wherever the turn reveals something new. For this step the REGISTER CARD above is satisfied BY IMAGE 1: do not re-render, smooth, sharpen or restyle.

Change ONLY the direction he faces: show him facing SCREEN-LEFT (a three-quarter side view from above). The CAMERA DOES NOT MOVE: the same elevated view looking down as in IMAGE 1 (top of the helm and shoulder tops visible). The light does not move: soft, from screen upper-left. NO MIRRORING: he is turned, never flipped — the pollaxe stays in his ANATOMICAL RIGHT hand, upright, butt on the ground beside his front foot, whichever side it lands on screen; the tabard's gold heraldry keeps its own layout (its back carries the same gold cross-crosslets and bands). Same rest pose, same size, proportions and framing as IMAGE 1; full body, feet fully visible, centred; flat uniform pure #00ff00 background; nothing else.

One image_gen EDIT call. ONE retry only if the direction is wrong, the pollaxe changed hands, the knight was restyled, or the background is not flat green — name the reason. Copy the output to out/KL-4-W.png with sha256. No code. No other files. No web.
RETURN: receipt task_id "KL-4-W"; images = the file with prompt, references (role + path) and elapsed_s; calls_used = the TRUE number of image_gen calls; status; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.

references.role: IMAGE 1 — THE IMAGE TO EDIT (approved ladder frame; preserve the painter's hand)
IMAGE 2 — the original manuscript miniature: the painter's hand (not its pose, fence or background)
